Oracle Fusion Supply Chain & Manufacturing 26B: what changed

We track 25 Supply Chain & Manufacturing changes in 26B, out of 320 features (our count) in Oracle's 26B What's New documents for this area. 23 of them are delivered switched on; 2 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Delivered switched on (23)

Calculate the Cost of Products After Assigning Phantom Subassembly Materials and Resources to Operations

Impact: high (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
If you're a manufacturing enterprise and want granular control and auditability over the components consumed as part of the phantom subassembly in production process, you can now cost the materials and resources consumed in the phantom subassembly with the correct operation.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Calculate the Costs of Standard Costed Configured Items On Demand

Impact: high (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
You can now calculate and publish the costs of all your configured items, even if those items don't have a new work order or purchase order in the application, if you use the standard cost method to value your inventory.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Perform Lot Split, Merge, or Translate Transactions Using a Redwood Page

Impact: high (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Inventory Management
When managing goods under lot control, various situations may require you to split, merge, or otherwise adjust the lot assignments for certain items. For instance, if a weather incident damages your warehouse and only part of a lot is affected, the compromised portion might still be suitable for some manufacturing uses but not others.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Review and Select Lot and Serial Numbers from an ASN or Transfer Order during Receipt

Impact: high (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Receiving
When you receive lot or serial control goods with lot or serial numbers mentioned in an Advance Shipment Notice (ASN) or transfer order, it's important to review and select specific lot or serial numbers, instead of automatically accepting all the numbers provided.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Use the All Organizations Option When Selecting an Organization

Impact: high (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Inventory Management
Certain roles within your organization, such as supply chain operations managers or regional managers, often require access to data across multiple inventory organizations to effectively oversee and coordinate activities at various locations.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Track Costs for Parallel Work Order Operations Using Precedence Constraints

Impact: high (draft)Automatically on (setup may apply)Supply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
You can now plan for your product costs when your work definitions have parallel operations enabled. This allows for accurate calculation of your product costs, when using the standard cost method.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Redwood: Set Up Customer Pricing

Impact: high (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingOrder Management · PricingRedwood Platform
Use the new Customer Pricing page in the Pricing Administration work area to set up pricing differently according to each of your customer's unique requirements.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Simulate Demand Using Additional Details

Impact: high (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & Manufacturingdemand26b · Demand Management
Using the Simulate demand drawer from pivot tables in demand and demand and supply plans, you can select a forecasting profile; select output measures, forecasting methods, and levels; and run a simulation that produces decomposed results (totals and by forecasting methods).

AI Agent: Configuration Advisor

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Configure to Order
Use an AI agent to help you identify the optimal configuration for a configured item according to your inputs. Use the agent to compare two or more configurations and select the best one.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Account for Component Scrap in Work Order Costs Without Material Returns

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
You can now scrap an already issued component to a work order without having to do a component return. You can move the scrapped item to a specific subinventory where it can be reviewed before a final disposition.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Calculate and Track Product Costs when Using an Item Multiple Times in a Discrete Work Order Operation

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
If you use an item multiple times in a discrete work order operation or in a flow schedule, you can now calculate your product costs and cost the transactions. Additionally, if you use standard cost, you can track variances by the item and basis type.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Complete the Same Output Across Multiple Operations in Discrete Manufacturing

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
You can now add co-products and by-products to different operations in a discrete work definition or work order, with enhanced support for accurate cost calculations.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Derive Receivables and Payables Accounts for External Trade Events Using Transaction Account Definition

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Supply Chain Financial Orchestration
Earlier, when you uploaded and processed intercompany transactions from Oracle subscriptions or external sources into Financial Orchestration to generate receivables and Payables invoices, you were required to set up the control accounts of receivables and Payables in Advanced Global Intercompany System (OAGIS) using the new external trade as a business flow in the financial agreement.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Enable Accurate Capture and Fiscal Processing for Prepayments Under the New Tax Regime

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Fiscal Document Capture
You can now record, tax, and track supplier prepayments against purchase orders before goods are received in Brazil’s standard procure-to-pay fiscal flows. With the new Prepayment fiscal flow for source document type Purchase Order , the system automatically associates and applies prepayments to final invoices, ensuring:
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Generate Intercompany Events for Oracle Transportation Management Interface for Customer Drop Shipments

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Supply Chain Financial Orchestration
Financial Orchestration Transfer Prices REST resource is used by applications like Oracle Global Trade Management to print import or export documentation based on who owns the goods at the time of customs clearance.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Export All Search Results on the Completed Transactions Page

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Inventory Management
The Completed Transactions page serves as a critical auditing and investigative tool, providing visibility into historical inventory activity used to research and reconcile on-hand inventory discrepancies.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Execute Work Order Operations with Enhanced Options

Impact: high (draft)Opt-in, expires 26CSupply Chain & ManufacturingManufacturing · Manufacturing
